_comment: Subscription display names that the rebrand could not reach, recorded because they are customer-facing and Apple will not let the API change them yet.
finding: pro_annual_standard has 16 localizations still reading 'Glovebox Pro (Annual)'. pro_annual and pro_monthly localizations are already 'Wrenchy Pro' - only this one product was missed. store/pro_annual_standard.json in this repo already holds the correct localized names; they were simply never applied to App Store Connect.
whyItMatters: src/purchases/index.ts:12 documents that the *default* offering deliberately sells the no-introductory-offer products - that is pro_annual_standard. So this is the product on the first paywall a new user sees, and it is branded with the old name.
blocker: asc subscriptions localizations update -> HTTP 409: 'Cannot edit SubscriptionLocalization when it is in ACTIVE state'. All three subscriptions are state=APPROVED, so their localizations are locked the same way a READY_FOR_SALE version locks name/description. Changing them requires an App Store Connect subscription-review submission, not an API write.
remedy: In App Store Connect, edit the pro_annual_standard display name per locale (values are in store/pro_annual_standard.json) - this moves the subscription to 'Ready to Submit' and it is reviewed alongside an app version.

The three internal reference names ('Glovebox Pro (Annual)', 'Glovebox Pro (Annual, no trial)', 'Glovebox Pro (Monthly)') are ASC-internal only, never shown to users, but worth renaming in the same pass so `ship submit` stops printing the old brand.
notBlockingRelease: 1.0.1 passed `asc validate` and was submitted for review with these outstanding; the subscription promotional-image findings are warnings, not blockers.
